result.title: Train-Only-Constrained LM for Synthetic Clinical Trajectories: Leak-Safe Calibration and Auditable Dynamics
result.comment: Preprint (pre-review version, 6 pages, 2 figures). Accepted at SECURE AI4H@AAAI 2026, Singapore. Extended version to appear in Springer CCIS vol. 3004 (2027): https://link.springer.com/book/9789819239238
result.summary: Simulating clinical time series necessitates temporal realism, calibration that preserves model integrity, and privacy transparency. We present a train-only, constrained language-model pipeline that factorizes generation. A compact GPT-style language model learns cross-biomarker co-occurrence through quantile tokens, and temporal directions are enforced by 3x3 per-biomarker Markov transitions fit on TRAIN, allowing dynamics to be audited. We fit a monotone quantile map (QMap) on TRAIN only (SYN(TRAIN) -> SIM(TRAIN)); no TEST statistics are used. The fixed map is then applied to SYN(TEST) severities. The constrained LM demonstrated improved distributional fidelity and co-occurrence in a 5,000-patient simulated testbed (parameters within published clinical ranges) compared to an empirical sampler, maintained near-chance detectability after a small lambda-sweep, and exhibits temporal adherence by construction. A classifier-based membership-inference audit results in an AUC of approximately 0.5; we make no differential-privacy claim. We present multi-seed results with paired 95% confidence intervals and quantify the severity of QMap's alignment (Delta W1 with confidence interval). This is a Stage-1 method result obtained on a controlled simulator; Stage-2 validation on real EHR cohorts with clinical endpoints is planned.

AI.brief_summary: 提出仅用训练集约束的语言模型流程，通过量化 token 生成临床多生物标志物轨迹，并用按生物标志物拟合的 3×3 马尔可夫转移强制时间方向，配合单调分位映射与成员推断审计评估保真度、校准和隐私透明度。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向表格化临床时间序列的合成数据生成与隐私校准，既不涉及视觉或多模态推理，也未讨论 latent 推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策；受限 AR 生成与马尔可夫转移约束属于生成建模细节，未提供可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
